summary: prosocks installs a proxyjacking agent registered to kalnetz.store at pip-install time
details: setup.py's PostInstallCommand runs on `pip install` and, without user consent or README disclosure, writes ~/.prosocks/config.json with a hardcoded panel URL and silently spawns a detached background process `python -m prosocks https://kalnetz.store` with stdout/stderr redirected to DEVNULL. The spawned agent binds a SOCKS5 server to 0.0.0.0:9050 with a locally generated password, queries api.ipify.org for the host's public IP, and POSTs an agent id, hostname-derived agent name, listening port, SOCKS5 password, and public IP to https://kalnetz.store/api/register, with periodic /api/heartbeat/ callbacks and re-registration on IP change. The operator of kalnetz.store can then connect to the installer's host on port 9050 with the reported credentials and route arbitrary outbound traffic through the installer's network (residential-proxy / proxyjacking abuse), while also inventorying installer public IPs and hostnames.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
